description: Agent Customs Records: submit duty and fee payment records with the entries they answer to: the moment the records are read at and the days after entry within which the records say duty is paid; each entry with its id, entry number, the moment filed, the classified value, the duty rate in percent and the currency; each duty payment with its id, reference, the entry it pays, the moment paid and the amount; each customs fee with its id, the entry it is recorded against, the entry its fee statement names, the fee and the amount; each duty refund with its id, the entry, the original payment it returns, the moment refunded and the amount. The signed report gives the entries and the payments, the duty paid on each entry recomputed from its classified value and rate, each unpaid entry against its payment window, each fee against the entry its statement names, and each refund against the original payment it returns, and counts them, and names divergent duty and fee records: duty paid that does not recompute from the classified value and the recorded rate, an entry past its payment window with no payment recorded, a fee recorded against the wrong entry, and a refund of duty recorded with no matching original payment; then a payment naming an entry the records do not hold and a refund above the payment it returns, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No entries, an entry with no classified value or rate, or no reading moment or payment window beside unpaid entries leaves those points unverified. Entries, payments, fees and refunds match by letters and digits, a refund to its payment by the payment reference or id on the same entry, duty recomputes as the classified value times the rate to the cent against the payments for one entry added together, an entry at a zero rate owes nothing, and an unpaid entry inside the payment window waits. This reads duty as paid at entry, against the entry it answers to. Verdict customs_duty_divergent, customs_duty_partial, customs_duty_unverified or customs_duty_consistent. POST /api/customs-duty-check. Reads the customs and trade records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it files no entry, pays no duty, contacts no customs authority or broker and gives no customs or legal advice, which stay with the importer, its licensed customs broker and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Customs Records reads an importer’s or exporter’s own customs and trade records: entry summaries, tariff classification records, duty and fee payment records, broker filing records, country-of-origin and marking records, declared-value records, customs bond records and drawback claim records, each against the commercial invoices and duty payment records, the rulings on file, the entries, the importer’s own copies, the origin support on file, the invoices and payments, the entry activity or the duty recorded as paid and the proof on file. The family’s ground is the paper behind the border crossing: what was declared, how it was classified, what duty was paid, and whether the bond and the drawback claims line up; the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the tax authority, and the Agent Logistics family reads where a shipment is and when it moves, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-customs-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-customs-records/.

as_of.description: The moment the duty records are read at, such as 2026-03-02.

entry.description: The entry the fee is recorded against.

kind.description: The fee, such as merchandise processing fee.

statement_entry.description: The entry the fee statement names.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

payment_days.description: Days after entry within which the records say duty is paid.
